research_subquestion: Does the published LPWM retain useful object and future information after NAVSIM domain post-training, before learning an action policy?
initial_checkpoint: published Sketchy best_lpips, never an earlier NAVSIM-adapted checkpoint

data.selection: official log AND token filter, complete RGB sequences, stable hash then recording round-robin; no scenario or performance selection

training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch; epoch checkpoints for diagnosis only

loss.implementation: official DLP.forward and calc_dyn_elbo, full encoder/context/dynamics/RGB decoder

visualization.scene_selection: fixed hash within straight/turn/projected_overlap/other; same development frames at every snapshot
visualization.particle_identity_warning: Particle color and ID identify a patch-origin particle, not a persistent object track

adaptation_gate.comparison: paired recording bootstrap, 2000 resamples, 95 percent interval
required: final reconstruction LPIPS lower than published checkpoint, paired CI upper bound < 0
final past-only 4-second forecast LPIPS lower than published checkpoint, paired CI upper bound < 0
final past-only 4-second forecast LPIPS lower than last-frame persistence, paired CI upper bound < 0
final forecast object-region MSE lower than last-frame persistence, paired CI upper bound < 0
top16 object-box recall IoU0.1 noninferiority vs published checkpoint, paired CI lower bound >= -0.02
finite outputs, nonzero gradients and weight changes in all four core modules, and observed-particle causality check
adaptation_gate.stage2_on_failure: do not start a planner; report the unmet criteria and diagnosis
adaptation_gate.stage2_on_success: merged stage2: low learning rate LPWM fine-tuning with full planner training

deviations_from_original: NAVSIM front RGB at 2 Hz, cropped and resized to 128 square
12-frame clips within unchanged learned temporal embeddings
post-training starts from public pretrained weights, no from-scratch warmup
single seed domain-adaptation run, not a replication of the original paper
no added ego FiLM, object labels, trajectory loss, selectors or planner in stage1
Two-GPU DDP, per-rank microbatch2 accumulation4, global batch16; final partial batch padded deterministically
